newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian treasury raises 12 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian treasury raises 12 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury raised 12 million dinars at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated February 25 and repaid maturing paper totalling 21.4 million dinars.
The issue was at a 7.0625-percent coupon rate for 52-week bills, unchanged from its level last week.
Banks bid for 333 million dinars for 13-, 26-, 52-week and two-year paper at between 6.9375 and 7.3750 percent. The Treasury issued only 52-week paper. ($=1.07 dinar)
